translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Am"etuwaa Zoreedda Zoriyaa
C'ima asaa ne aabba bonchchiyaawaadan bonchchappe attin, toochchoppa. Yalagatuwaa ne ishaadan,
k'ay c'ima mac'c'a asaa ne aattiidan, yalaga mac'c'a asaa ne michchatiidan, kumentsaa geeshshatetsaan bonchcha.
Bare s'alalaa gideedda tumu am"etuwaa bonchcha.

Shin am"attiw naanay woy naanaa naanay de'ooppe, he naanay S'oossaa malatiyaawaa barenttu soy asaa bessiyaawaaninne k'ay hewaa ootsiyaawaan barentta yeleeddawanttu kushiyaa zaariyaawaa tamaarino. Ayaw gooppe, hewe S'oossaa nashechchiyaawaa.
Ayaa maaduukka baynna bare de'iyaa tumu am"atta S'oossay immana gaade nashechchan naaga uttaaddu. K'ay gallassinne k'amma S'oossay izo maaddana mala, woossawunne oochchaw.
Shin barena ishalissiyaa am"atta pas'a de'ooppekka, iza hayk'k'adiggaaddu.
K'ay ooninne unttuntta borenna mala, ha azazuwaa imma.
Shin barenttuwoo k'ay ubbaappe aatsiide, bare soy asaw k'oppenna uray oonanne gidooppe, hewe bare ammanuwaa kaddeeddawaa. Ammanenna asaappekka aad'd'iide aw iita.
Usuppun tammu laytsay kumibeenna am"atti suntsaa maziggobiyaan s'aafoppa. Hewaa bollan k'ay iza itti asinaappe haraa gelabeennawunno gidanaw koshshee.

Naanaa dichchiyaawan, imatsaa mokkiyaawaan, geeshshatuwaa gediyaa meec'c'iyaawaan, waayetteedda asaa maaddiyaawaan, lo"o oosuwaa ubbaa kaalliyaawan, ha lo"o kiitaa kiitettiyaawaan eretteeddawunno gidanaw bessee.
Shin yalaga am"etuwaa yekkonttu suntsaanna gatsa s'aafoppa. Ayaw gooppe, unttunttu barentta, asinaa gela gela giyaa wode, Kiristtoosa agganawantta.
Koyro ammanuwaa kad'eedda diraw, unttunttu pirddettana.
Hewe baynnaan oosuwaa d'ayiide itti golliyaappe hara golliyaa yuuyyiidde, hamettiyaawaa salalaa gidennaan, barenttoo bessenabaa haasayiidde, zigirssaanne yewuwaan c'oo geliyaawaa tamaariino.
Hewaa diraw, nu morkketuu nu bolla haasayiyaa iitabaa demmenna mala, yalaga am"atuu asinaa geliide, na'aa yeliide, barenttu golliyaa ayissana mala zoray.
Ayaw gooppe, hawaappe kase amareeda am"atuu Sees'aanaa kaallanaw aggiide guyye simmeeddino.
Ammaniyaa mishirattiw hak'ankka dabbo am"atuu de'ooppe, iza unttuntta maaddanaw bessee. Ammaniyaa asatuu maaduu bessiyaa tumu am"etuwaa maaddana mala, unttunttu ammaniyaawanttoo tooko gidoppino.
Loytsi heemmiyaa c'imatuu, k'ay ubbaappe aatsiide, k'aalaa odiyaawaaninne tamaarissiyaawaan daaburiyaawanttu, dakko bonchchuwaa akkanaw bessiino.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa Mas'aafay, «Uddumaan katsaa yed'd'iyaa booraa doonaa k'achchoppa» k'ay, «Oosanchchay bare dirgguwaa akkanaw bessee» yaagee.
Laa"u woy heezzu markkay baynnaan, woosa golliyaa c'imaa mootiyaawaa sisoppa.
Haratuu yayana mala, nagaraa ootsiyaa ubbatuwaa asaa ubbaa sintsan seera.
Neeni ayinne asaa deemuwaa s'eellennan, ittuwaa ittuwaappe dummayennan ha azazuwaa naagana mala, S'oossaaninne Yesuusi Kiristtoosan dooretteedda kiitanchchatuwaa sintsan neena taani zoray.
O bollaaninne elleellaade ne kushiyaa wotsoppa. Haratuwaa nagaraan geloppa. Neena geeshshatetsaan naaga.
Neeni ubbaa wode sakettiyaa dirawunne ne uluwaa diraw, guutsa woyniyaa eessaa ushappe attin, haatsaa s'alalaa ushoppa.
Itti itti asatuwaa nagaray be'anaw k'onc'c'e; unttunttu nagaray unttuntta pirddanaw unttunttuppe sintsaw aad'd'ee. Shin haratuu nagaray guyyeppe k'onc'c'ee.
Hewaadankka, lo"o oosuukka k'onc'c'ee. K'onc'c'ibeennabaa gidooppenne, geemmanaw danddayenna.
